description: The channel of the host hooks (goal item B6): the `apassy-hook` program, the host settings with the hook configuration, and the host transcripts of Claude Code and Codex. An agent could use them to send a false user request or to change a transcript.

rules.note: The text of the command names the hook program, a host settings file or directory, or a variable that moves them. The check covers the words, `NAME=value` prefixes, redirect targets, and here-documents, in any case.
A word that ends in `.claude` or `.codex` names a host directory, for example `cd ~/.claude`.
